This instant criminal misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.38/2022 pending in the Court of Special Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (PCPNDT Cases), Jodhpur Metropolitan, District Jodhpur and all consequential proceedings for offence under Section 498-A IPC on the basis of compromise entered between the parties.

entities.text: Special Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (PCPNDT Cases), Jodhpur Metropolitan, District Jodhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and respondent No.2/complainant are husband and wife.

They have entered into a compromise in the spirit of Lok Adalat and settled their dispute amicably, therefore, the impugned Criminal Case and (2 of 2) [CRLMP-6583/2022] all consequential proceedings for offence under Section 498-A of IPC may be quashed on the basis of compromise.
Learned counsel for the complainant-respondent concurs the fact of compromise.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioner and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in Rakesh Soni vs State Of Rajasthan on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102412411/
1 which it has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the criminal proceedings for offence under Section 498-A IPC are liable to be quashed.
